title: health check endpoint returns service status
description: Test GET /health endpoint to verify it returns 200 status with HealthResponse containing status, version, timestamp, and cache entry count.

title: fishing zones listing returns all zones
description: Test GET /conditions/zones endpoint to verify it returns 200 status with an array of FishingZone objects including id, name, coordinates, and metadata.

title: current conditions all zones with valid auth
description: Test GET /conditions endpoint with valid Authorization header to verify it returns 200 status with AllConditionsResponse containing zones and computed risk levels.

title: current conditions all zones without auth
description: Test GET /conditions endpoint without Authorization header to verify it returns 401 Unauthorized.

title: current conditions specific zone valid
description: Test GET /conditions/{zone_id} endpoint with valid Authorization header and valid zone_id to verify it returns 200 status with ZoneConditions including wave height, wind speed, and computed risk level.

title: current conditions specific zone unknown
description: Test GET /conditions/{zone_id} endpoint with valid Authorization header and unknown zone_id to verify it returns 404 Zone not found.

title: marine forecast valid zone with auth
description: Test GET /conditions/{zone_id}/forecast endpoint with valid Authorization header and valid zone_id to verify it returns 200 status with ZoneForecast containing daily summaries and hourly breakdowns with dominant risk levels.

title: marine forecast unknown zone
description: Test GET /conditions/{zone_id}/forecast endpoint with valid Authorization header and unknown zone_id to verify it returns 404 Zone not found.

title: marine forecast without auth
description: Test GET /conditions/{zone_id}/forecast endpoint without Authorization header to verify it returns 401 Unauthorized.

title: upstream failure returns service unavailable
description: Test GET endpoints /conditions, /conditions/{zone_id}, and /conditions/{zone_id}/forecast to verify they return 503 Marine data service unavailable when Open-Meteo upstream service fails or times out.
